one_liner: Programmatic access to LinkedIn’s Marketing platform to create/manage ad campaigns, audiences, leads, and reporting across LinkedIn Ads.
access_notes: Access is via the LinkedIn Developer Portal; you must apply for each Marketing/Advertising product and obtain LinkedIn’s review/approval for tier upgrades.
blocker_notes: LinkedIn Marketing/Advertising APIs require applying for product access and passing LinkedIn’s review (Development -> Standard tiers) before meaningful production use.

evidence.quote: The LinkedIn API uses OAuth 2.0 for member (user) authorization and API authentication.
Important — 2‑legged OAuth authentication is not available for Marketing APIs
Apply to the desired API under the Products tab of your app… Complete the access form.
LinkedIn has two tiers of access to our Advertising API: Development and Standard… Open to qualified developers… all API Calls at all access levels are made on production data.
Starting March 16, 2026, new lead notifications will only be pushed to webhooks that have been validated.
